mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 900K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 900K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS < 1% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) rises by > 0.5pp in 2 months, signaling labor market stress, S&P 500 returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 2mo.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong supply-side momentum, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window when INDPRO growth > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) above 800K and increasing real personal consumption (RSAFS) above $370B signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both triggers are met.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 2% in 3 months, signaling monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher borrowing costs reduce investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly lower when FEDFUNDS rises > 2% in 3mo (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE) below 6%, indicating a strong labor market, contributes to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors anticipate sustained consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% YoY and rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150K/month signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 30% of instances when both triggers are met.
